'''Aveton Prit''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] informer who operated the [[Cantina/Legends|drinking establishment]] [[Pritt's Free Pit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
